Usage: protonvpn config set custom-dns [OPTIONS] {off|on}

  Configure custom DNS servers.

Options:
  --dns TEXT  Comma-separated DNS server IPs (IPv4 or IPv6)
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

  Values:
    off   Disable custom DNS (use Proton's DNS)
    on    Enable custom DNS with specified servers
  
  Examples:
    # Enable with custom DNS
    protonvpn config set custom-dns on --dns 1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8
  
    # Enable with IPv6
    protonvpn config set custom-dns on --dns 2606:4700:4700::1111
  
    # Disable custom DNS
    protonvpn config set custom-dns off
  
  Current Setting:
    Run 'protonvpn config list' to see current DNS configuration.
